== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]] (Original text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif Holotable image repository, commit 2494181] “Set 22”, 1 October 2023. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.
